patch.description: Optional theme corners and kurbo rounded-outline endpoint intersections; upstream decision fan-out backport for all graph directions. Lone selected-face ports are centered during assignment and refinement, including backward cycle links; crowded faces, loops and subgraph anchors keep upstream lane separation. Opt-in orthogonal_only rejects diagonal shortcuts, keeps bounded midpoint side-search profiles and axis-safe grid/fallback paths; the adapter enables it only for flowcharts. Ready upstream parser, layout, obstacle-aware router, labels, rounded bends and bounds remain in use. For opt-in orthogonal flowcharts up to 64 edges, a detected micro-U-turn can reuse existing local detour/shoulder candidates in at most two passes over 32 windows; exact terminal directions, endpoint reentries, every obstacle/label, crossings and overlap cannot worsen. Self-loops and larger fast-tier graphs are skipped. Ordinary opt-in Diamond fan-in from distinct sources shares the main-axis input vertex, including initial assignment beyond refinement budgets. Shared targets do not occupy outgoing tracks or collide with each other; loops, cycles, duplicate pairs, subgraphs and custom link styles keep prior ports. Existing endpoint repair restores lost input normals with one fixed-port candidate when only this semantic debt exists; hard geometry retains the prior all-sides safety search.

backports.adaptation: TD rule rotated into the pre-finalize LR/RL/TB/BT coordinate systems. Selected fan routes use centered target ports and a matching centered baseline. Sources with outgoing loops, backward links, parallel pairs or subgraph crossings keep existing routing.

reviewed_upstream.finding: Current author code still refines ordinary port offsets toward remote nodes; no general lone-face center rule was available.
